en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside settlement surrounded by forested hills. In the foreground a long bridge crosses a river where logs are floating or stacked along the banks, suggesting timber activity. The bridge leads into a small town with scattered wooden buildings, church spires and houses amid trees. The overall scene is rural and panoramic, taken from an elevated vantage point. In the upper left corner there is printed text in a Scandinavian language.
